name: zcode-token-usage-statusbar
description: ZCode token usage query (token_usage MCP tool, /usage command, skill) reading the local usage DB; automatically installs/repairs the floating usage status bar by default when config or key is missing (modifies app.asar; quit completely and reopen after success; explicit false is preserved; env takes precedence; uninstall opt-out blocks reinjection; corrupt/non-boolean config does not enable it without an env override); appends a per-answer rate line (tok/s incl. thinking, TTFT, output tokens, generation time, segments/peak, session total) at the end of each reply, guarded by --current so a previous turn's data is never shown as the current one.

description_i18n.en: ZCode token usage query (token_usage MCP tool, /usage command, skill) reading the local usage DB; automatically installs/repairs the floating usage status bar by default when config or key is missing (modifies app.asar; quit completely and reopen after success; explicit false is preserved; env takes precedence; uninstall opt-out blocks reinjection; corrupt/non-boolean config does not enable it without an env override); appends a per-answer rate line (tok/s incl. thinking, TTFT, output tokens, generation time, segments/peak, session total) at the end of each reply, guarded by --current so a previous turn's data is never shown as the current one.
description_i18n.zh-CN: ZCode token 用量查询：token_usage MCP 工具 + /usage 命令 + 技能（只读本地 usage 数据库）；缺配置文件或缺字段时默认为桌面客户端自动安装/修复悬浮用量状态条（修改 app.asar，成功后需完全退出并重开；显式 false 保留，环境变量优先，卸载豁免阻止重注入，无环境变量覆盖时损坏/非布尔配置不开启）；每次回答末尾自动追加逐问速率行（即时 tok/s 含思考、首字延迟、输出 token、生成耗时、段数/峰值与会话累计），--current 守卫保证绝不把上一轮数据当作本问显示。
